scope: 5 s pilots of the declared fixed 128^3 six-neighbour graph; 8 runs x 2000 steps. No reference labels in training. Prior and loss-objective changes explicit.
limitations: Reference convergence is temporal at a fixed spatial graph, not convergence to continuous local PDE.
Tanh trial function includes exact initial geometry and known constant latent forcing; compare untrained prior before attributing gains to training.
Raw phase control is a short-budget failure and does not establish failure of all fully converged raw networks.
Same-grid positive-node counts are quantized; zero measured volume error does not mean exact continuous volume.
The first geometry-only audit used default matmul precision and is excluded; retained highest-precision audit matches training.
No production train.py/losses.py defaults, historical checkpoints or external artifact paths changed.
